entities.summary: Jennifer Warling is a karateka from Luxembourg. She is a four-time medalist, including gold, in the women's kumite 55 kg event at the European Karate Championships. She is also a two-time bronze medalist in her event at the European Games. Jenny Warling was a architects & designers from Luxembourg (b. 1994-03-25, Luxembourg). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
